capabilities: Render a full-year mood calendar with three months per row
Record moods by clicking empty days or a today's-mood command
Read mood values from frontmatter, inline fields, or tags
Open a sticky note showing a day's mood detail
Create missing daily notes when recording a mood
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README also covers manual installation from release assets.
intentEvidence: Why Another Mood Calendar? Existing Obsidian plugins can track mood, render heatmaps, or help insert emotion words.
motivation: The author wanted a yearly mood tracker that keeps mood data in Markdown inside daily notes and shows the emotional texture of a year with readable calendar structure instead of a dense heatmap.
problem: Obsidian mood plugins are either dense heatmaps or store mood history in a separate JSON database, separating the data from the user's journal notes.
summary: Yearly mood calendar plugin that reads mood values from daily notes via tags, frontmatter, or inline fields and renders them as custom SVG faces in a quarter-by-quarter layout.
